messages.content: What did Jim pull from Hugson's Siding?
The buggy.
What did he say when he first spoke?
Well, that's better!
Who looked at one another in wonder after he spoke?
Dorothy and Zeb.
Where did Zeb work for Uncle Bill?
On his ranch.
How much did his uncle pay him a month?
Six dollars.
Where did Dorothy stay after getting to San Francisco?
In the city with some friends.
How long did she plan to stay at Hugson's Ranch?
Only a day.
Where were she and Uncle Henry setting out for the next day?
Kansas.
What color was the streak on Dorothy's face under the colored suns?
Green.
What about Zeb?
Blue.
What slowed the buggy's fall into the chasm?
The top of the buggy caught the air like a parachute.
Why couldn't the Wizard's balloon rise again?
He had let too much gas out.
What did the Wizard set on each child's head to make new suns?
A lantern.
What could the visitors do after rubbing the leaves on their feet in Voe?
Walk on the water without sinking.
Who shod the Sawhorse with gold?
Princess Ozma.
Why?
It saves his legs from wearing out.
What did the Wizard get so Dorothy could see the archway more clearly?
His spy-glass.
Where did the Wizard put the invisible piglets to keep them safe?
In his pocket.
What was Ozma's saddle made of?
Red leather.
In her throne room during the trial, what did Ozma hold in her hand?
Her jewelled sceptre.
